name: Mahli
overview: Mahli is a male descendant of Mushi from the tribe of Levi, identified specifically as a Mushite. The Mushites trace their lineage through Mushi, a son of Merari, who was himself a son of Levi, establishing Mahli firmly within the Levitical family line. This heritage situates Mahli within the priestly tribe dedicated to service in the tabernacle and temple.
namesAndTitles: The name Mahli is a proper name that may mean 'shrewd' or 'cunning,' though this meaning is not definitively established. It is not indicated that this name was given directly by God. The biblical record references this name specifically in 1 Chronicles 23:23.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Mahli as a descendant of Mushi, linking him to the Mushite branch of the Levites. Beyond this direct lineage, no additional family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Mahli's significance lies in his identification as part of the Levitical lineage descending from Mushi, which highlights the organized tribal divisions within the Levites. This connection underscores the importance of genealogical records in maintaining the order and responsibilities assigned to the Levites, who served in various capacities related to worship and the upkeep of the sanctuary. His mention in 1 Chronicles 23:23 places him within the broader context of the Levitical families' roles under the Mosaic covenant.
